Absolutely tragic to see three brave service members lose their lives in a training exercise. 

Rebecca and I are thinking of these fallen soldiers, their families and the entire @USMC. 

https://t.co/V0pANrFRTq

Thanks to CEO & President Dave Jolly for showing me the upgrades at @cornerstonefh which allow the site to now house a range of community health services, including internal medicine, dental care, mental health and nutrition counseling for women, infants and children.

Extreme rainfall is expected to continue across the Hudson Valley. 
 
Please stay alert and exercise caution.  

Stay off the roads if you can and should you need emergency assistance, dial 9-1-1.

Our military families make huge sacrifices for our country - we are forever indebted to them.

I’m proud to champion legislation that delivers the support they deserve, from healthcare to nutrition to housing.

#MilitaryFamilyAppreciationMonth https://t.co/9Q6nED1i7Z

Honored to celebrate the graduation of veterans from the Newburgh Veterans Drug Treatment Court, a truly inspiring organization.

We owe our veterans a debt that can never be repaid - I'm working every day to deliver the support they deserve. https://t.co/lzjd2InIoc

DaVita Dialysis in Wallkill goes above & beyond, caring for our neighbors with treatments, nutrition, insurance access, & holistic support.

Grateful that Maria from my team joined them for a great discussion on working together to continue delivering quality healthcare to NY-18! https://t.co/alDchNh7WI

Exercising the right to vote is a sacred responsibility and is vital for a healthy democracy.

On today’s #VoterRegistrationDay, make sure you’re registered & ready to exercise your right by visiting https://t.co/64lU0Li4nz

During this #NationalRecoveryMonth, I want to tell everyone in recovery:

Your strength is inspiring & the Hudson Valley is proud of you.

Every day, I’m working to make treatment & resources for those in recovery easier to access - no family should lose a loved one to addiction.

No child should go hungry - that’s why a key component of my Youth Agenda is tackling food insecurity for families.

This #HungerActionMonth, I’ll keep pushing to get bills like the The Military Family Nutrition Act &  my Lower Grocery Prices Act passed & signed into law. https://t.co/KtKYhgnCbl

This Halloween, remember President Obama's words: "Don't Boo - VOTE" no matter who you're voting for.

That's why I'm fighting for legislation like the John R. Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act to ensure every American can access the ballot box & exercise this sacred right. https://t.co/uzsPJbSuRD

The bill:

Cuts $ for pediatric cancer research
Eliminates Medicare coverage for breast & cervical cancer early detection
Cuts $ for World Trade Center Health Program
No SUPPORT ACT (opioid treatment)
Lets big pharma keep ripping people off

And still adds $4 trillion in debt!
I heard from parents of disabled children unable to get treatment. https://t.co/C1EybdKJbN
Mothers waiting a year to be seen before a cancer diagnosis. https://t.co/6VgZahFAYP

The “More Funding for COPS Act” ensures that our officers are getting fair treatment – because our kids, our communities, and our country are all safer when we support our cops.

Read more: https://t.co/OFJuZ93NGq

I heard from parents of disabled children unable to get treatment.

Mothers waiting almost a year for a cancer diagnosis.

Families slammed by thousands of dollars of overcharges.

All so the largest health care company in the world can continue to make record-breaking profits.

I risked my life to defend every American’s right to free speech. 

If you choose to exercise your first amendment rights this weekend, please do it peacefully – and remember to uphold the values of our flag and all it represents while you do.

Trump’s cuts are a burden that the Hudson Valley simply can’t afford.

It impacts us all – kicking hard working folks off their health care, raising costs, and closing hospitals & clinics.

Today I proudly stood with healthcare leaders & workers on the frontline of this battle. https://t.co/FxF4gLr37f

Bring back the local, independent doctors offices & pharmacies who care for you – not United’s earnings report.

Bring down the price of your care.

Break down the endless roadblocks.

Pass my Patients Over Profits Act.

During this #MentalIllnessAwarenessWeek, I want to say to everyone living with mental illness: you are strong, brave, & not alone.

Every day, I will fight for the resources & support you need. Find treatment options at https://t.co/4wT7vAiuFK https://t.co/wC2KH9MEJ7

We’re already feeling the harms of Trump’s devastating health care cuts in the Hudson Valley.

People are losing coverage. Costs are skyrocketing. Hospitals are cutting services.

These are burdens our community simply cannot afford. https://t.co/rlc69U8TaA

We already have 17,000 of our neighbors – veterans, single parents, disabled people – receiving letters in the mail that they will lose coverage entirely.

It is completely wrong and deeply un-American.

I won’t stop fighting for a more affordable Hudson Valley: 

https://t.co/lp7r18SIfQ

Medicare open enrollment runs through December 7.

Just like my team helped Deborah, we're here to help you navigate the process & get the coverage that's right for you, too. Please reach out at 845-443-2930 or at https://t.co/bz3zJoYMc7. https://t.co/8fSqAPBAoq

Hudson Valley families shouldn't have to choose between putting food on the table or paying a 185% increase in health care premiums.

I won't stop fighting to protect our community against these harms.

Health insurance premiums are set to skyrocket across the Hudson Valley. 240K of our neighbors are at risk of losing coverage altogether.

I’m fighting back & I need YOU to join me.

Are your health insurance premiums increasing? Take my survey https://t.co/FoYz2xmrWU https://t.co/Y1im5Bstmq

The right to vote is at the core of our democracy - we each have a duty to exercise it.

Please remember to vote this Election Day! https://t.co/ymk86uw7aK
